stories.title: Tom Kim Wins Asian Games Gold — Military Exemption Secured

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Tom Kim shot 64 in the final round to win Asian Games gold — finishing 18-under, winning by 3. 🇰🇷

The 24-year-old secures an exemption from South Korea's mandatory military service.

#TomKim #AsianGames #Golf

"It's a crazy feeling." — Tom Kim 🥇 #TomKim #Golf
